name: call_fft_over_equation_budget_rejected
source:
{ The vector kernels are budgeted the same way: the two 7000-long inputs fit,
  the 2 x 7000 output equations do not. }
re = linspace(0, 1, 7000)
im = zeros(7000, 1)
CALL FFT(re, im : fr, fi)

error.message: Too many equations generated (over 25000). Reduce loop or array sizes.
